metaDescription: Order custom 6 xlarge workwear in bulk for your team. Durable, comfortable, and branded with your logo. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: When your crew includes workers who need 6XL sizes, standard workwear just doesn't cut it. Our custom 6 xlarge workwear ensures a proper fit for everyone, from hi-vis jackets to safety vests and durable aprons. Whether you're outfitting a construction team or warehouse staff, these larger sizes provide the same durability and comfort as standard options, with plenty of room for movement. Add your logo through screen printing or embroidery for a professional look that fits every body type.
